name: Keeping A Confidence
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of guarding our speech and maintaining trust by not spreading harmful tales or revealing secrets. The Lord commands His people not to act as talebearers who harm their neighbors (Leviticus 19:16), and the psalmist prays for God’s help to guard his words (Psalms 141:3). Wisdom is shown in discretion and restraint, as excessive talk leads to sin, but restraining the lips is wise (Proverbs 2:11; 10:19). A faithful spirit conceals matters rather than revealing them, and covering transgressions fosters love, while repeating offenses divides friendships (Proverbs 11:13; 17:9). These verses collectively teach that keeping confidence is an expression of godly wisdom and love.
